a.text: Heads up: storms hit at 80% after each round, so following the plan (operating to 8 first) means we both very likely end round 1 with 0 cells and fail. The reserve only has 4 now, enough for one of us. I'd like to agree openly on something better rather than either of us grabbing in secret. One option: one of us takes 4 now and the other takes the next 4 after we operate. Tell me what you'll do this round. I won't hide my action from you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I'm operating with you, sticking to the agreement. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
